packages.name: fdp-bardwell-creek-2d-flood-study-review-final-report
packages.notes:
The study was commissioned by Bayside Council, with the assistance of the NSW Government Office of Environment and Heritage (OEH). Additional information has been provided by Sydney Water Corporation (SWC).

The Flood Study comprises the development of computational hydrologic and hydraulic models that define design flood behaviour for the 20% AEP (0.2 EY), 10% AEP, 5% AEP, 1% AEP and 0.5% Annual Exceedance Probability (AEP) design storms and the Probable Maximum Flood (PMF) in the Bardwell Creek and Wolli Creek catchments.
